sn45.42-47:1.1: Sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || || Kim atthi yam āvuso samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyam vussatī ti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam añña- parib- evam vyākareyyatha || || Saṃyojanapahānatthaṃ kho āvuso Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || la || -anusayasamugghāṭanatthaṃ kho avuso Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || la || || -addhānapariññatthaṃ kho avuso Bhagavati {brahmacariyaṃ} vussatī ti || la || -āsavānaṃ khayatthaṃ kho āvuso Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || || -vijjāvimuttiphalasacchikiriyatthaṃ kho āvuso Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || la || || -ñāṇadassanatthaṃ kho āvuso Bhagavati brahmacariyam vussatī ti ||
